en: The postcard features a sepia-toned, historical photograph of a quiet, cobblestone street lined with old European buildings. One prominent structure is a timber-framed house that protrudes slightly over the street. A man in old-fashioned attire stands on the sidewalk, adding to the turn-of-the-century ambiance. The architectural style points to Northern Europe, with detailed brickwork and wooden façades. Text in French is printed on the front, identifying the location.
